name: data.gov.uk CKAN API (health subset)
provider: UK Cabinet Office / Central Digital and Data Office
licence: Datasets vary; most are Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Check each package's license_id field.

key_endpoints.purpose: Full-text search across UK government datasets; filter to health with q=health or fq=topic:health.
Fetch a single dataset including its resources (CSV/JSON file URLs).
List datasets published by an organisation (e.g. NHS Digital).

gotchas: Hitting https://data.gov.uk/api/3/... returns a 301 to ckan.publishing.service.gov.uk — point readers at the resolved host. Many resources link out to opendatani.gov.uk or other portals; CKAN gives you metadata + a URL, not always the bytes.

name: Office for National Statistics Beta API

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"items":[{"description":"Provisional counts of the number of deaths registered in England and Wales, by region...","id":"weekly-deaths-region","last_updated":"2026-05-14T09:22:38.44Z","national_statistic":true,"release_frequency":"Weekly","state":"published","title":"Deaths registered weekly in England and Wales by region"}, ... ,{"id":"suicides-in-the-uk","title":"Suicide registrations in England and Wales by local authority"}], "count":20,"total_count":337}

key_endpoints.purpose: List all ONS datasets; filter result client-side or paginate with limit/offset.
Metadata for the weekly deaths dataset (England and Wales by region).
Retrieve actual observations for a given dataset version with dimension query params.

gotchas: This is the BETA API replacing the decommissioned legacy https://api.ons.gov.uk/timeseries/ (retired 14 October 2024 per Sunset response header). Endpoints under /timeseries/ now return 404. Some legacy /datasets/{id}/timeseries probes still 404; use the editions/versions/observations path instead.

name: openFDA (drug events, drug labels, device events, food enforcement)
licence: U.S. public domain (https://open.fda.gov/license/). Disclaimer: data unvalidated, not for clinical decisions.
rate_limits: 1,000 requests per IP per day without a key; 120,000 per day with a free key. Burst limit 240 per minute.

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"meta":{"disclaimer":"Do not rely on openFDA to make decisions regarding medical care...","license":"https://open.fda.gov/license/","last_updated":"2026-04-28","results":{"skip":0,"limit":1,"total":20328575}},"results":[{"safetyreportid":"5801206-7","transmissiondateformat":...}]}

key_endpoints.purpose: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) reports for drugs.
Structured Product Labeling (SPL) for drugs — indications, dosage, warnings.
Medical device adverse event reports (MAUDE).
Food recall enforcement reports.

gotchas: Anonymous limit is per IP per day (1,000) — easy to hit when developing. The free key is OPTIONAL, not required. Use search= with Lucene syntax (field:value). Date ranges use [20200101 TO 20201231].

name: RxNav (RxNorm) API
licence: RxNorm is in the U.S. public domain (NLM open-access).

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"drugGroup":{"conceptGroup":[{"tty":"BPCK"},{"tty":"SBD","conceptProperties":[{"rxcui":"262095","name":"atorvastatin 80 MG Oral Tablet [Lipitor]","synonym":"Lipitor 80 MG Oral Tablet","tty":"SBD"},{"rxcui":"617314","name":"atorvastatin 10 MG Oral Tablet [Lipitor]"}]}]}}

key_endpoints.purpose: Look up RxNorm concepts for a drug name (returns brand, generic, ingredient variants).
Properties of an RxNorm concept by RxCUI.
Approximate-match search for an RxNorm term (handles typos, partial names).
Status of an NDC (National Drug Code) and its mapping to RxNorm concepts.

gotchas: RxNav also exposes RxClass, NDF-RT, RxTerms — same host. The Drug Interaction API (/interaction/interaction.json) has been removed entirely and now returns 404 — do not rely on it.

name: CDC Open Data (Socrata)
provider: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
licence: U.S. public domain (federal government works). Per-dataset terms occasionally apply.
rate_limits: Higher limits with an app token; anonymous calls are throttled — Socrata recommends a token for production but works fine without one for low volume.

key_endpoints.purpose: Browse the dataset catalogue (id, name, category, description) to find a dataset four-by-four ID.
Query a specific dataset using SoQL (SQL-like) parameters.

gotchas: Each dataset has a four-by-four ID like pj7m-y5uh. Old IDs (e.g. 9mfq-cb36 for early COVID daily counts) have been retired and now 404; check data.cdc.gov in a browser to confirm the dataset still exists before hardcoding an ID. Use $limit, $offset, $where, $select per SoQL spec.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
licence: Public domain (U.S. government work). Terms of use: https://clinicaltrials.gov/about-site/terms-conditions

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"studies":[{"protocolSection":{"identificationModule":{"nctId":"NCT00953147","briefTitle":"A 6 Month Safety and Efficacy Study of Once Daily Ciclesonide Hydrofluoroalkane (HFA) in the Treatment of Perennial Allergic Rhinitis (PAR) in Subjects 12 Years and Older"},"statusModule":{"overallStatus":"COMPLETED"}}}]}

key_endpoints.purpose: Search studies by free-text term, condition, intervention, location, etc. Returns paginated study records.
Fetch a single study by NCT ID with full protocol, results and metadata.
Aggregate counts and study-size statistics across the database.

gotchas: Old hosts api.clinicaltrials.gov and the v1 paths return DNS or 404 errors — always use https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/. Use nextPageToken for paging, not skip/offset.

name: Europe PMC REST API
provider: EMBL-EBI, on behalf of the Europe PMC Funders' Group, in collaboration with the U.S. National Library of Medicine
licence: Service is free; individual articles vary (open access / restricted). Search metadata is generally free to reuse.
rate_limits: Documented fair-use; no hard published limit

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"version":"6.9","hitCount":678457,"resultList":{"result":[{"id":"42103518","source":"MED","pmid":"42103518","doi":"10.1016/j.landig.2026.100988","title":"An online singing-based breathing and wellbeing programme (ENO Breathe) in people with long COVID breathlessness in the UK: a cohort study.","journalTitle":"Lancet Digit Health","pubYear":"2027"}]}}

key_endpoints.purpose: Search biomedical literature across PubMed, PMC, preprints, patents.
Fetch full-text XML for open-access articles.
Retrieve references cited by an article.

gotchas: Pagination is cursor-based (cursorMark), not page numbers. Default format is XML; pass format=json.

name: NCBI E-utilities (PubMed, PMC, MeSH, etc.)
provider: U.S. National Library of Medicine / NCBI
licence: U.S. public domain for NCBI-produced content. Some embedded content (e.g. third-party abstracts) is copyrighted; respect publisher rights.
rate_limits: 3 requests/sec per IP without a key (10/sec with a free key). Hard limit confirmed via X-RateLimit headers.

key_endpoints.purpose: Search any NCBI database (pubmed, pmc, mesh, gene, etc.) returning UIDs.
Fetch document summaries for a list of UIDs.
Fetch full records (XML for PubMed, etc.).

gotchas: Anonymous rate limit is strictly 3 req/s. Always send tool= and email= parameters as identification (recommended by NCBI). retmode=json works for most but efetch falls back to XML for some dbs.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) OData API
licence: WHO data are generally available under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO (https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/copyright). Verify per-indicator.

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"@odata.context":"https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/$metadata#Indicator","value":[{"IndicatorCode":"EMFLIMITPOWERDENSITY900","IndicatorName":"Power density limit at 900 MHz (W/m^2)","Language":"EN"},{"IndicatorCode":"FINPROTECTION_CATA_TOT_25_LEVEL_SH","IndicatorName":"Population with household spending on health greater than 25% of total household budget (SDG 3.8.2)"},{"IndicatorCode":"HIV_0000000009","IndicatorName":"Reported number of people receiving antiretroviral therapy"}]}

key_endpoints.purpose: List all GHO indicators with codes and names; large response — paginate via OData $top/$skip.
Fetch the observations for a specific indicator (e.g. WHOSIS_000001 for life expectancy).
List country dimension values for filtering observations.

gotchas: Hosted on Azure Edge — quoting of querystring filters can be fussy. Use OData syntax like $filter=SpatialDim eq 'GBR'. The /Indicator list is large; cache locally.

name: HAPI FHIR Public Test Server (R4)
provider: Smile Digital Health / HAPI FHIR project
licence: Test server: data is synthetic / user-submitted. No real PHI. Apache-2.0 software; no formal data licence — treat as public test data.
rate_limits: Best-effort public sandbox; not for production load. Operator may rate-limit abusers.

key_endpoints.purpose: CapabilityStatement — what the server supports.
Search Patient resources (FHIR R4 search params: name, identifier, birthdate, etc.).
Search clinical observations (vitals, labs, etc.).

gotchas: Sandbox: data is public-test, schema may include odd user-submitted resources. State is shared — anyone can POST. Send Accept: application/fhir+json for JSON; default may be XML.

name: Disease Ontology (DO) API
provider: Institute for Genome Sciences, University of Maryland

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"definition":"A synucleinopathy that has_material_basis_in degeneration of the central nervous system that often impairs motor skills, speech, and other functions.","id":"DOID:14330","name":"Parkinson's disease","parents":[["is_a","synucleinopathy","DOID:0050890","obo"]]}

key_endpoints.purpose: Fetch a Disease Ontology term (e.g. DOID:14330) with definition, parents, synonyms, xrefs.
Free-text search across disease names and synonyms.

gotchas: Endpoints permanent-redirect (308) to a trailing-slash URL — make sure your client follows redirects. Returns a session cookie which can be ignored.

name: EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4)
licence: OLS service is open; individual ontologies carry their own licences (mostly CC-BY, CC0, or Apache).
rate_limits: none documented; service is HATEOAS-style with _embedded/_links

key_endpoints.purpose: Paginated list of all ontologies loaded into OLS (HPO, MONDO, EFO, GO, SNOMED subsets, etc.).
Details for one ontology (e.g. hp, mondo, efo).
Search terms across all ontologies; filter by ontology= and type=.

gotchas: Responses follow HAL/HATEOAS conventions (_embedded, _links). The hostname is www.ebi.ac.uk — not a separate api host.

name: NLM Clinical Tables Search Service (ICD-10-CM, LOINC, RxTerms)
licence: U.S. public domain (NLM). Underlying code systems (ICD-10-CM, LOINC) carry their own terms; ICD-10-CM is public, LOINC is free with a use agreement at the source.
rate_limits: none documented; long-cache headers indicate caching is encouraged

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: [19,["J45.998","J82.83","J45.909","J45.991","J45.20","J45.30","J45.40"],null,[["J45.998","Other asthma"],["J82.83","Eosinophilic asthma"],["J45.909","Unspecified asthma, uncomplicated"],["J45.991","Cough variant asthma"],["J45.20","Mild intermittent asthma, uncomplicated"]]]

key_endpoints.purpose: Type-ahead search for ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes.
Search LOINC lab codes.
Search RxTerms (consumer-facing drug names with strength/form).

gotchas: Responses are a JSON array, not an object: [total, codes, extra, displayFields]. Don't expect a typical name/results envelope.

name: OHID Fingertips Public Health Data API
provider: Office for Health Improvement and Disparities (OHID, formerly PHE), Department of Health and Social Care

key_endpoints.purpose: List all geographic area types Fingertips supports (England, regions, ICBs, local authorities, GP practices, MSOAs, wards).
List all Public Health Profiles (e.g. Tobacco Control, Cardiovascular, Child and Maternal Health) with their group IDs and indicator counts per area type.
Metadata (units, definitions, methodology, age/sex stratification) for one or more indicators.
Bulk CSV download of all values for an indicator across an area type. Returns CSV with value, CIs, count, denominator, time period, trend, comparator.
List all areas at a given area_type_id (e.g. all upper-tier local authorities, all ICBs, all GP practices).

gotchas: The JSON /indicator_data and /latest_data endpoints return HTTP 500 (with a browser-not-supported HTML body) for many parameter combinations — the API expects specific child/parent area_type_id pairings that are not consistently documented. The /all_data/csv/by_indicator_id endpoint is more reliable for bulk retrieval and returns text/csv. Area type 15 = England, 6 = Region (E12), 7 = GP, 66 = upper-tier local authority, 302 = ICB. Use /profiles to discover valid group_id + area_type_id combinations before requesting indicator data.

name: HDR UK Health Data Gateway API
licence: Catalogue metadata available under permissive terms for discovery; underlying datasets are NOT in the API — Gateway only exposes metadata. Access to actual data requires a Data Access Request to the data custodian.

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"current_page":1,"data":[{"id":1718,"pid":"8fda5a7d-2206-415d-9199-f15a44dc4afc","team_id":94,"create_origin":"MANUAL","status":"DRAFT","latest_metadata":{"metadata":{"metadata":{"summary":{"title":"Royal United Hospitals Bath National Pain Centre Complex Pain Outcomes","abstract":"This dataset holds high-quality, large-scale detailed clinical information about some of the UK's most severely affected people..."}}}}}],"total":1600}

key_endpoints.purpose: List dataset catalogue entries (1600+ as of May 2026) with summary, abstract, custodian, keywords, structural metadata.
Full metadata for a single dataset including provenance, coverage, accessibility (DAR process), tissue/omics/linkage details.
List data custodian teams (NHS trusts, research organisations, biobanks) that publish datasets to the Gateway.
Curated thematic dataset collections (e.g. cardiovascular, respiratory).

gotchas: Host is api.healthdatagateway.org — the api.www.healthdatagateway.org variant does NOT resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN). The API exposes metadata only; data itself sits behind Data Access Request workflows handled outside the API. The 'metadata' field is deeply nested (latest_metadata.metadata.metadata.summary) — wrapper layers reflect a versioned schema. Status field includes DRAFT, ACTIVE — filter accordingly if you only want published datasets.

name: NHS Business Services Authority Open Data Portal (CKAN)
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Confirmed via license_id=OGL-UK-3.0 in dataset metadata.

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"help": "https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/help_show?name=package_search", "success": true, "result": {"count": 612, "facets": {}, "results": [{"author": "NHSBSA Data Services support team", "license_id": "OGL-UK-3.0", "license_title": "Open Government Licence 3.0 (United Kingdom)", "name": "prescriber-details", ...}]}}

key_endpoints.purpose: Full-text search the 600+ NHSBSA datasets (English Prescribing Data, BNF code information, pharmacy contract data, dispensing contractor payments).
Fetch full metadata + monthly resource list for a dataset. Each English Prescribing Data (EPD) month is a separate resource (EPD_YYYYMM) with its own resource_id.
Query a specific monthly resource as rows (SoQL-style filter by ICB_CODE, PRACTICE_CODE, BNF_CHAPTER, etc.). This is the actual prescribing record retrieval, not just metadata.
Bare list of all dataset slugs — useful for discovery without paging through package_search.

gotchas: English Prescribing Data (EPD) has one resource per month — resource_id pattern is EPD_YYYYMM (e.g. EPD_202401 for Jan 2024). Use package_show to discover the current month's resource_id before calling datastore_search. ICB_CODE and PRACTICE_CODE align with ODS codes (cross-reference with the Spine ODS API). Some older notes fields contain inline HTML.

name: NHS Organisation Data Service (ODS) ORD API
provider: NHS England (Spine services / formerly NHS Digital)

verification_evidence.response_excerpt: {"Organisation":{"Name":"GUY'S AND ST THOMAS' NHS FOUNDATION TRUST","Date":[{"Type":"Operational","Start":"1993-04-01"}],"OrgId":{"root":"2.16.840.1.113883.2.1.3.2.4.18.48","assigningAuthorityName":"HSCIC","extension":"RJ1"},"Status":"Active","LastChangeDate":"2023-11-14","orgRecordClass":"RC1","GeoLoc":{"Location":{"AddrLn1":"ST THOMAS' HOSPITAL","AddrLn2":"WESTMINSTER BRIDGE ROAD","Town":"LONDON","PostCode":"SE1 7EH","Country":"ENGLAND"}}}}

key_endpoints.purpose: Search organisations by name, postcode, primary role, status. Returns a list with OrgId codes and links.
Full record for one organisation (e.g. RJ1 = Guy's and St Thomas') — name, address, roles, relationships (parent ICB, commissioner), operational dates.
Lookup table of all OrgRole codes (RO177 = Prescribing Cost Centre, RO197 = NHS Trust, RO198 = NHS Trust Site, RO261 = ICB, etc.).
Delta sync — returns links to organisations whose records changed since LastChangeDate. Use to maintain a local mirror.

gotchas: OrgId codes are the canonical NHS reference for every Trust, GP practice, pharmacy, ICB, commissioner — cross-references NHSBSA prescribing data (ICB_CODE, PRACTICE_CODE), Fingertips (GP-level area codes), and most NHS datasets. PrimaryRoleId is the right filter for narrowing (e.g. RO261 = ICB, RO177 = GP practice). The /sync endpoint requires LastChangeDate or it 406s — that's a parameter error, not auth. PostCode field is empty for many legacy records.

name: UKHSA Data Dashboard API

key_endpoints.purpose: Top-level navigation: lists themes (infectious_disease, immunisation, climate_and_environment). Drill down by following the link in each entry.
Time-series data for a metric (e.g. COVID-19_cases_casesByDay) at a geography. Each row is one observation with date, metric_value, stratum, sex, age, in_reporting_delay_period flag.
Discover available geography_types and metrics for a topic without enumerating from /themes.

gotchas: This is the live replacement for the decommissioned api.coronavirus.data.gov.uk (DNS no longer resolves as of 2026-05-18). Path is deeply hierarchical (theme/sub_theme/topic/geography_type/geography/metric) — follow the links returned at each level rather than constructing paths by hand. Pagination is page=N querystring; respect 'next' URL.
